hlt: halt: enter endless loop. Due to lack of interrupts, should never be used
trunc: move higher size value into lower size location
ext: move lower size value into higher size location
copy: copy set amount of bytes from one location in memory to another
shr: binary shift right operation between two values
shl: binary shift left operation between two values
jnz: jump to specified address if specified register IS NOT equal to zero
jz: jump to specified address if specified register IS equal to zero
call: push current address onto the stack and jump to the address
ret: pop value from the stack and jump to it, resuming execution
log: output information about anything to console
line: write set amount of `=` to separate chunks of logs
